# tasks.condition_registration { #operetta_compose.tasks.condition_registration }

`tasks.condition_registration`

Register experimental conditions as a plate-level table in an OME-Zarr plate.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [condition_registration](#operetta_compose.tasks.condition_registration.condition_registration) | Register the experimental layout as a plate-level condition table. |
| [read_layout](#operetta_compose.tasks.condition_registration.read_layout) | Read an experimental layout file and normalize the well identifiers. |

### condition_registration { #operetta_compose.tasks.condition_registration.condition_registration }

```python
tasks.condition_registration.condition_registration(
    zarr_urls,
    zarr_dir,
    layout_path,
    condition_table_name='condition',
    table_backend='parquet',
    overwrite=False,
)
```

Register the experimental layout as a plate-level condition table.

The layout file must contain at least the columns ``row`` and ``column``
(or ``col``) identifying the well and can have an arbitrary number of
additional metadata columns (e.g. drug, concentration, medium, sample).
Only the wells that are actually present in the plate are registered.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                 | Type                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                               | Default       |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| zarr_urls            | list\[str\]                                            | List of paths to the OME-Zarr images of the plate (provided by Fractal for a non-parallel task).                                                                                                          | _required_    |
| zarr_dir             | str                                                    | Path to the directory containing the plate (provided by Fractal; unused, kept for the Fractal non-parallel task signature).                                                                               | _required_    |
| layout_path          | str                                                    | Path to a layout file (e.g. ``.csv``) with at least the columns row and column (or col).                                                                                                                  | _required_    |
| condition_table_name | str                                                    | Name of the plate-level condition table to write.                                                                                                                                                         | `'condition'` |
| table_backend        | Literal\[\'anndata\', \'json\', \'csv\', \'parquet\'\] | ngio table backend used to store the condition table. ``parquet`` is a compact columnar default; ``csv`` keeps the table human-readable inside the OME-Zarr; ``anndata`` and ``json`` are also supported. | `'parquet'`   |
| overwrite            | bool                                                   | Whether to overwrite an existing condition table.                                                                                                                                                         | `False`       |

### read_layout { #operetta_compose.tasks.condition_registration.read_layout }

```python
tasks.condition_registration.read_layout(layout_path)
```

Read an experimental layout file and normalize the well identifiers.

The layout is a delimited text file (``.csv`` / ``.tsv``) with at least a
``row`` and a ``column`` (or ``col``) column identifying the well, plus an
arbitrary number of metadata columns (e.g. drug, concentration, medium).
This matches the condition-table format of the
[fractal-uzh-converters](https://github.com/fractal-analytics-platform/fractal-uzh-converters)
Operetta converter.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description              | Default    |
|-------------|--------|--------------------------|------------|
| layout_path | str    | Path to the layout file. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                           |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | The layout with the well identifiers renamed to the canonical ``row`` |
|        | pd.DataFrame | and ``column`` columns (as strings) placed first.                     |
